segments.he: אֵין הַטַּבָּחִין נֶאֱמָנִין [וְכוּ׳]. אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: חָזְרוּ לוֹמַר נֶאֱמָנִין.
segments.en: § The mishna stated (89b): «Butchers are not deemed credible» to say that the sciatic nerve was removed; this is the statement of Rabbi Meir. And the Rabbis say: They are deemed credible about the sciatic nerve. «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba says» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan says:» The Rabbis initially held that butchers are not deemed credible about the sciatic nerve, and subsequently «they retracted» and «said» that butchers are «deemed credible» in this regard.
